result.judge_notes: pass 1 (A=without, B=with): B is a proper journey map. It runs in time order from the first search through to month three, with rows for what the new member does, asks and feels, plus rows for the studio's touchpoints and what to change. Every count is given as 'of 6' and gaps are marked [to collect]. A is legible and accurate, but month three is cut off below the fold, the bad moments aren't visually marked, it has no row for studio touchpoints, and it adds a claim ('That's the moment people stayed') that the conversations don't support. | pass 2 (A=with, B=without): A lays out all seven phases in time order, through month three, on one screen. It has rows for what the studio owns ('where it touches us') and an opportunity for each phase, and it highlights the worst moments. Its one weak spot is that the trial-class high isn't visually emphasised. B is readable and accurate on counts, but the visible page never reaches month three or the renewal doubts. It gives bad and good moments the same card styling, says little about what the studio controls, and adds claims nobody made, such as 'That's the moment people stayed.'
